description: Per-theorem attribution record for a depth-k sequence candidate, crediting a sequence only when it produces a genuine new win over literal production search.

record_shape.sequence_runner_solved: bool|null — did the custom (proxy) runner solve it

controls.A_initial: solved|failed|unknown — first sub-tactic alone on the initial goal
controls.B_initial: solved|failed|unknown — last sub-tactic alone on the initial goal
baseline_controls_solved: string — any depth-1 controls observed to solve (simp/simp_all/aesop/...)

baseline_winning_path: string — baseline tactics_used path, if any

classification_rules_ordered.note: literal production already solves it; check trace for equivalent A->B continuation to confirm subsumption mechanism
only when baseline did not finish but an equivalent generic family closed it under a different path

classification_rules_ordered.if: baseline_finished == false AND candidate_finished == true AND A_then_B == solved AND controls fail AND NOT equivalent_sequence_observed AND trace_confidence != insufficient

credit_policy: Only TRUE_SEQUENCE_DELTA carries credit=true. Default-to-no-credit for TRACE_INSUFFICIENT and NEEDS_REVIEW.

summary_shape.over_credit_caught: bool — true if the proxy runner credited theorems that SX4 reclassifies to non-credit
